You see Golgordan.
  • Latrivan, you fool!
  • We are the right hand and the left hand of the seven!

Notes

The walls of the room is filled with Magicthrowers, Flamethrowers, Plaguethrowers and Shredderthrowers. Also Latrivan, his brother, is in the same room.

It's one of the bosses of The Inquisition Quest.
